newsitem.title: UK: BASF in talks again about Kali & Salz sale.
newsitem.headline: BASF in talks again about Kali & Salz sale.

text.p: Germany's chemicals group BASF AG on Thursday said it was in talks to sell its Kali & Salz (K&S) unit after an earlier divestment attempt was blocked by the German government.
"We are looking into the feasibility for various offers which are already on the table," chairman Juergen Strube told journalists here.
Last month, Germany blocked the sale of BASF's 51 percent stake in K&S to Canada's Potash Corp on competition grounds. K&S already has 80 percent of the German market.
"We don't see Kali & Salz to be a strategic fit for BASF," Strube said.
Separately, BASF deputy chairman Hans-Helge Stechl said a decision on where to site a new cracker in the U.S. would be announced "some time before the end of this year."
He said BASF was still considering whether to build the cracker in Louisiana or Texas.
